model.title: Carson City Public Land Correction Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Jacky Rosen (D-NV)

summary.text: The bill would transfer certain federally owned land in Carson City, Nevada to local or state control. It aims to correct previous public land designations in the area and facilitate local development and use of these properties.
